summary_en: ITG-G Holdings will launch a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Kadoya Sesame Mills at 2,514 yen per share from September 15 to October 30, 2026, with a minimum acceptance threshold of 13,847,100 shares and settlement on November 9, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Commencement of a Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of Kadoya Sesame Mills Incorporated (Securities Code: 2612) by ITG-G Holdings Inc.
translation_en_brief:
ITG-G Holdings Inc. announced the commencement of a tender offer for ordinary shares of Kadoya Sesame Mills Incorporated, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. The tender offer will be conducted from September 15, 2026 to October 30, 2026 at a price of 2,514 yen per share.

The bidder plans to acquire a maximum of 23,079,969 shares with a minimum acceptance threshold of 13,847,100 shares. Settlement of the tender offer is scheduled to commence on November 9, 2026. The offer period spans 30 business days. The announcement does not disclose the bidder's ownership stake in the target company prior to the tender offer or the stated rationale for the transaction.
